Record Class IuEntityDao.Search<E>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.iu.dao.IuEntityDao.Search<E>
Type Parameters:
E - entity type
Record Components:
parent - parent to filter results by, as accepted by IuEntityDao.tryBinding(Object, E); may be null
filter - additional filter applied after the parent filter; null to accept every row
from - start of range, inclusive
to - end of range, exclusive; null for end of list
Enclosing class:
IuEntityDao<K,I,E>
public static record IuEntityDao.Search<E>(Object parent, Predicate<E> filter, int from, Integer to) extends Record
Passes the post-processing a search applies to the rows it reads.

The static factories capture the active IuEntityDao.parent() of the calling thread, so a Search created outside any parent scope carries a null parent.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
